# mabinogi-013 — establishment log (2026-11-14)

Evans 1907 cols 94 l. 10 – 101 l. 17 (PDF pp. 79–83). Every column read on the page image (zoom 4, three crops per
column; zoom 10–18 for single lines). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate
disagreements and for punctuation and paragraph shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r;
ſ → s; raised letters into the line; letters Evans prints with a single dot beneath (the scribe's expunction) left
out; line-end marks, Evans's dotted/wavy underlines, the suspension stroke over *ȳ gyt* (col 101 l. 2), the stray
"'" before *arueu* (col 100 l. 25) and the "/" after *pob* (col 97, last line) dropped. Red Book = Rhŷs & Evans
1905 (source/raw/rhys-evans1905_djvu.txt).

Tooling note: page 79/81/83 cols at x ≈ 0–122 / 110–228; page 80/82 x ≈ 95–215 / 205–335. Text y ≈ 40–405.

## Opening and close
- col 94 l. 10 — the part begins mid-line after "… a hwnnw a uu trydyd anuat ergyt." (012's close): "Val yd oed
  Wydyon diwarnawt …". No large initial.
- Close: col 101 l. 17 "… ac y arglwydiaeth." — 014 begins on the same line, "Ac yna treigylgueith …".

## Worklist items (20 check + 16 loss), decided on the image
OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the image agrees with the witness: col 94 ll. 11 (deffroi), 15 (agori), 16
(gist), 22 (a bronneu … Ac ym-); col 95 ll. 1 (see below), 2 (diwyrnawt), 10 (see below), 12 (uyg kywilydaw,
kywilyd), 24 (drwc), 25 (yd wyt), 31 (A thrannoeth), 32 (a mynet); col 96 ll. 2 (brithaw), 6 (Aranrot), 7
(dechreu llunyaw), 10 (see below), 20 (hitheu), 33 (Ef a dywet-); col 97 ll. 10 (see below), 14 (ys llaw gyffes),
16 (see below), 21 (hwnnw); col 98 l. 29 (see below); col 99 ll. 1 (see below), 3 (gynghan), 5 (a glywynt), 28
(gwryanc); col 100 ll. 11 (gwr drwc), 25 (paryssei), 26 (see below), 35 (thelediwaf); col 101 l. 5 (see below).

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 95 l. 1 — **"yn gyuareisket ac ef"**: Evans *gẏuareiſket*, certain at zoom 12 (wavy underline under *uar*);
  the witness's *gynureisket* is not on the page. Red Book *yn gŷ ureiscet*. NOTE FOR DRAFTER: the form is odd (an
  equative 'as big as' of *breisc* is expected); kept as printed, say so.
- col 95 l. 10 — **"Pa uab yssyd y'th ol di?"**: Evans *ẏth ol*; witness *i'th*. Red Book *ythol*.
- col 96 l. 10 — **"dwy eu heilyw e hun a oruc"**: Evans *d6ẏ* at the line end, no n (zoom 12). A slip for *dwyn*
  (Red Book *dôyn*; witness silently *dwyn*). Kept as written; NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 97 l. 3–4 — **"na uedrut kymedroli esgidyeu wrth uessur"**: no gap in Evans; the witness's "[ar wneuthur]" is
  the Red Book's (*gymedroli ar wneuthur esgidyeu*). Not supplied: the White Book reads ('moderate shoes to a
  measure'). NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 99 l. 1 — **"Erbyn pan oed y dyd yn goleuhau"**: Evans prints a raised y before *dyd* (into the line;
  Red Book *pan oed y dyd*); the witness drops it and misprints *goleuliau*.
- col 99 l. 18 — **"A pha beth a wnawn i?"**: Evans *a6na6n i* with a space; witness *wnawni*. NOTE FOR DRAFTER:
  *wnawn i* for *wnawn ni* (the n of the pronoun absorbed; Red Book *awna6n ni*).
- col 100 l. 6 — **"Och," heb, "pa ryw dygyuor …"**: Evans *Och heb. pa rẏ6* — *heb* with no subject, no blank.
  The witness supplies [hi]; Red Book *Och heb hitheu*. Not supplied: the speaker is plain from the dialogue (as with
  "Ie, heb mab Mathonwy" in 012). NOTE FOR DRAFTER: *heb* stands without its subject.
- col 100 l. 26 — **"keisswn inheu, ui a thi"**: Evans *keiff6n inheu*; witness *ninheu* (Red Book *ninneu*). Kept.
- col 101 l. 5 — **"y wr heb gyuoeth idaw ossymdeithawc"**: Evans *offẏmdeitha6c*, the final c certain at zoom 12;
  witness and Red Book *ossymdeithaw*. Kept as printed (an adjective in -awc, 'with no realm of his own to make a
  living by'?); NOTE FOR DRAFTER: the reading differs from the Red Book's verbal noun; meaning uncertain.

Expunged letter (dot beneath; left out):
- col 97 l. 16 — **"Neur gauas ef enw"**: Evans *ef ṇ en6*, the n dotted beneath (a false start of *enw*) → left
  out (witness agrees).

Marks, not letters:
- col 97 l. 27 "Je heb hitheu ¡" and col 98 l. 4 "o eiſſeu ¡", col 98 l. 29 "a guẏdẏon ¡" — Evans's "!"-like mark
  at the line end (as in 010/011); dropped.

Scribal forms kept as written (readable; for the drafter's notes):
- col 97 l. 10 — **"ar wwrd y llog"**: Evans *w6zd* = wwrd (witness agrees), and *llog* for *llong* (Red Book
  *ar vŵrd yllong*). Both kept.
- col 97 l. 11 — **"y rwg giewyn"**: Evans *ẏr6g*, for *y rwng* (witness agrees).
- col 97 — *y Lleu ef* (u) but *Llew Llaw Gyffes* (6-shaped w) in the naming and at col 97 last line; kept.
- col 99 l. 32 — **"A derw," heb ef**: Evans *Ader6* (for *deryw*; the answer has *Deryw*). Kept.
- col 99 l. 6 — *gyniweir*: faint print, read at zoom 18 as *gẏniweir* (Red Book *geniweir*). Slightly uncertain.
- col 94 — *hof* (single f) twice; *e hun*/*Ynteu e hun Wydyon*; *ac auar arnat*.
- col 100 — *Diodwn yn arueu* (Red Book *an harueu*); *ynn* 'to us'; *E rof a Duw* (Evans *Erof*).
- col 101 — *yg gwrthtir Ardudwy* (Evans *ẏgg6zthtir*); *Blodeued* (Red Book *blodeuwed*).

No words supplied; no blanks in the White Book here.
